title: Beneficiaries and cooling periods - explained
content: A beneficiary is the intended recipient saved for a transfer. Adding, deleting and activating a beneficiary are separate operations. Some products apply a waiting or cooling period to a newly added recipient; the applicable rule must come from that product's policy.
